title: About Me
subtext: I'm a Software Developer based in Edinburgh. I enjoy learning new things. At the moment, I'm currently interested in learning about hardware, as well as backend development.

title: Interests
subtext: Other than the technical aspects of software development, I enjoy trying new things and exploring different hobbies and activities such as bouldering and running. You can also find me holed up in different sides of nerd culture, whether it's gushing about musicals, or playing music at a Jazz Bar - or playing all sorts of games - both physically and digitally.
